quests.title: Carbon Chemistry Master Quest
quests.description: Explore the fascinating world of carbon compounds and organic chemistry!

story.introduction: Welcome to the Carbon Laboratory! Dr. Organic needs your help to understand the amazing world of carbon compounds.

steps.title: Carbon Bonding Investigation
steps.narrative: Dr. Organic shows you different carbon compounds. Analyze their bonding patterns!

problem.question: Why can carbon form so many different compounds?
options: It has 4 valence electrons and can form 4 bonds
problem.correct_answer: It has 4 valence electrons and can form 4 bonds
problem.explanation: Carbon has 4 valence electrons, allowing it to form 4 covalent bonds with other atoms, creating diverse compounds.
